battle.name: 瓜州之戰
battle.brief: 開元十五年（727）冬，吐蕃與葛邏祿聯軍進逼河西走廊西端的瓜州，安西留使薛仁貴據堡壘與疏勒河谷口，以弩砲封住隘道，再令副將阿史那道真率精騎衝擊聯軍側翼，逼其退回天山南北。羅馬弩砲是單發扭力弩，源自拆掉希臘城牆的攻城器材，此役只能守住幾段通道，決定勝負的已是騎兵、糧草與指揮體系。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰的一方是唐王朝，戰事由安西都護府與河西節度使兩條線分擔，野戰主力是安西留使薛仁貴所率的留府兵與西域募兵，後方則有隴右、河西兩處節度使的兵與從長安、關中調發的援軍。唐的指揮系統以安西大都護、河西節度使為前線，兵部掌軍籍，中書省議方略，戶部與度支核算轉運；糧草由隴右、關中沿驛道與烽燧線接力運至瓜州、沙州，兵源則兼有漢兵、關中募兵，以及安西都護府屬下的龜茲、焉耆、疏勒等地的胡漢兵卒。交戰的另一方是吐蕃帝國，時值赤松德贊普在位，吐蕃以邊軍屯田兵為骨幹，配屬各部落的徵發兵，步兵以長槍、大刀、弓箭為主，甲兵用皮甲、鎖子甲與鱗甲，騎兵數量龐大，軍中以氈帳、糌粑、酥油為主，搬運倚賴氌牛、馬匹與駱駝。第三方是葛邏祿部，即突騎施的別部，以游牧騎隊的形式加入聯軍，充當先鋒與迂回力量，其首領在漢籍中記作阿悉的多，名號有異文。兩造背後還各有更大格局：葛邏祿與大食往來密切，吐蕃稍後亦曾遣使向大食求婚，此役已牽入唐與大食爭奪塔里木盆地的長線競局。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Tang state, with the fighting carried by two separate administrative arms, the Protectorate General to Pacify the West and the Hexi Circuit. The field force was the army of the Resident Commissioner of Anxi, Xue Rengui, made up of troops of the protectorate and locally recruited soldiers, while the Hexi circuit troops and reinforcements drawn from Chang'an and Guanzhong supported from the rear. Tang command ran from the Protectorate and the circuit governor in the front to the Ministry of War, which held the personnel rolls, and the Secretariat, which settled strategy, with the Ministry of Revenue and the Department of State Finance reckoning the transport; grain and matériel came from Longyou and Guanzhong by the post road and the beacon relay to Guazhou and Shazhou, and the manpower mixed Han troops with recruits from Guanzhong and with Hu and Han soldiers of the protectorate's own oasis prefectures, Kucha, Karashahr and Khotan. The other belligerent was the Tibetan Empire under the emperor Tri Songdetsen. Its army was built on the frontier militia settled on farms, backed by levies drawn from the various tribes; its infantry fought with long spears, sabres and bows, its armoured men wore leather, mail and scale, and its mounted element was enormous. The army lived on felt tents, tsampa and butter, and shifted its baggage on yaks, horses and camels. The third party was the Karluq, a branch people of the Türgesh, who entered the war as mobile cavalry used as spearhead and as a turning force; their chief is recorded in the Chinese sources under the name Axi Duo, with variants in the transmission. Behind both sides lay a larger frame: the Karluq were in close contact with the Abbasid caliphate, and Tibet was later to send an embassy to the caliph asking for a marriage alliance, so the battle was already tied into the longer contest between Tang and the caliphate over the Tarim Basin.
people: 薛仁貴名禮，字仁貴，絳州龍門人，是唐廷最倚重的外族作戰統帥之一。他平高麗，破東突厥於金山，經略隴右，爵封平陽郡公，開元十五年也就是公元七二七年奉命出任安西留使，鎮守西域第一線。史籍記他在瓜州一役並不用大軍硬撼，而是令副將阿史那道真率精銳先出，據隘處橫擊，並在追擊中不斷收縮敵陣，使聯軍人數愈多反成了累贅。阿史那道真出身阿史那氏，隸薛仁貴部下，以驍勇善騎聞名，此役負責前鋒衝鋒與追擊掩殺，後歿於安西，追贈岑部縣公。吐蕃方面的統兵者是論悉諾，漢籍記其為吐蕃大將，領吐蕃與葛邏祿之眾來攻，戰敗退回本境。葛邏祿首領在漢籍中作阿悉得多，此戰之後部眾分散，一部分西投大食，一部分仍留天山南北。唐玄宗李隆基在長安策劃西域方略，宰相張說、源乾曜等參贊軍務，河西節度使方面負責西段的後勤與烽燧接應。敦煌所出吐蕃與漢文文書，則留下聯軍進軍方向、堡柵名稱與唐軍出沒的零星記載，與正史可以互證。
peopleEn: Xue Rengui, whose given name was Li and who came from Longmen in Jiangzhou, was one of the commanders of non-Han background on whom the Tang court relied most heavily. He had campaigned against Goguryeo, broken the Eastern Turks on the Jinshan, served in Longyou, and had been ennobled as Duke of Pingyang. In Kaiyuan 15, that is 727, he was appointed Resident Commissioner of Anxi and took charge of the westernmost line. The chronicles describe him as refusing to meet the enemy in open field with masses of men: he sent his deputy Ashina Daozhen out first with picked troops to strike from covered positions, and in the pursuit kept cutting the enemy off in pieces, so that the greater the number of the federated army the more it was a burden. Ashina Daozhen, of the Ashina clan, was a lieutenant of Xue Rengui famous for boldness and horsemanship; in this battle he led the advance and the pursuit, and was later killed in Anxi and posthumously granted the county of Cenbu. The commander on the Tibetan side was Lun Xinu, recorded in the Chinese sources as a Tibetan general who led the troops of Tibet and the Karluq against Guazhou and fell back to his own country after the defeat. The Karluq chief, recorded as Axi Duo in Chinese sources, scattered his people after the battle, some going west to the caliphate and some remaining in the Tian Shan. Emperor Xuanzong of Long'an planned the western strategy from the capital, with chancellors such as Zhang Yue and Yuan Qianyue advising on the military, while the Hexi circuit side handled logistics and the beacon relay for the western flank. Dunhuang Tibetan and Chinese documents preserve scattered notices of the federated army's line of advance, the names of forts and the movements of Tang troops, and these can be checked against the official histories.
kits: 任務所屬的羅馬弩砲是一具單發扭力弩，一發一具箭，羅馬人用它拆掉了希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。放到唐代邊軍的裝備序列裡，同源技術的東西就是弩：長形弩身、木製弩機，含弩臂、弦與機牙，一具或數具鐵質、骨質弩矢，須兩到三人合力操作，單人上弦即射難以持久，覆蓋角度也遠不如弓。它的價值在準而不在密，一箭之內可以精確命中遠處的旗幟、戰鼓、鼓手、督戰的將官，或者射斷城頭繩索、拒馬的皮索與渡索，逼迫對手放棄某段牆或某條通道。在瓜州這樣的河西隘口，弩砲更適合佈在堡柵缺口、峽口與營壘之間的封鎖點，用來封死敵軍的進攻路徑，而不是在開闊地上覆蓋整個戰場。唐軍的正面骨架仍由長槍步卒、環首刀、盾與步弓射手構成，騎兵分具裝與輕騎兩種編制，負責反擊與追擊，弓手佈在兩翼。吐蕃軍的裝備以長槍、刀、弓箭為主，甲胄有皮甲、鎖子甲與鱗甲，馬具齊全，重裝騎兵在遠距離衝撞時威力驚人，一旦陷於狹窄河道與戈壁便難以展開。攻城與野戰的輔助器械，兩軍都有雲梯、竿梯、拋石機一類的攻城具與壕壘器材；後勤運輸則倚賴駱駝隊、馬匹與牛車，把青稞、糌粑、麥粟、鹽與箭矢從隴右運到瓜州，一路上靠烽燧與驛站接力。
kitsEn: The weapon assigned to this battle, the Roman scorpio, is a single-shot torsion engine, one bolt per shot, used by the Romans to pull down the walls of Greek cities and with them the Greek polis system. Placed in the Tang frontier inventory, the same technology is the crossbow: a long stock, a wooden mechanism of bow arms, string and trigger, one to several bolts of iron or bone, worked by two or three men, slow to reload, and with a far narrower field of fire than a bow. Its value lay in accuracy rather than volume, for a single shot could pick off a distant standard, a drum, a drummer or a supervising officer, or sever the ropes on a wall, the lashings of a chevaux-de-frise and hauling cables, and so force a defender to abandon a stretch of wall or a line of passage. At a frontier gorge such as Guazhou, a weapon of the scorpio kind was best posted at the gaps in the palisade, at the mouths of the ravines and between the camps, to seal the enemy's road in, rather than to cover an open field. The front of the Tang line still rested on spearmen, ring-pommel sabres, shields and foot archers, with armoured and light horse used for the counterstroke and the pursuit and archers posted on the wings. The Tibetan arm was spearmen, swordsmen and archers, with leather, mail and scale armour and complete harness; their armoured cavalry was devastating at the charge but could not deploy in a narrow river course or on the Gobi. Both sides had the usual siege and field equipment, scaling ladders, hooked poles and stone-throwing engines, together with trench works, and their logistics rested on camel trains, horses and ox carts carrying barley, tsampa, wheat, salt and arrows from Longyou to Guazhou, relayed from one beacon station to the next.
tactics: 唐軍的部署以守點、誘敵、封口、反擊為主軸。安西留使薛仁貴先據瓜州一帶的城戍與烽燧，把弩砲與步弓佈在營壘之間以及通往上源的谷口，讓吐蕃與葛邏祿的聯軍無法一次展開；等聯軍沿疏勒河谷與戈壁通道進抵隘口時，唐軍以長槍步卒封住正面，以弩砲封鎖兩翼通道與坡面，用密集箭矢削弱聯軍先鋒騎兵。關鍵在阿史那道真所率的精騎，這支部隊不在正面消耗，而是從堡壘側後的高地或乾涸河道切入，攻擊聯軍的側翼與糧隊，把縱隊切成數段，逼其放棄攻勢。追擊階段，唐軍利用潰散後留下的空隙，不求全殲，只求截斷退路、迫使對方丟棄帳具與傷兵。聯軍的戰術是典型的高原加游牧立體作戰，以葛邏祿騎兵為尖錐高速度衝撞唐軍側翼，以吐蕃本部步騎在後列成厚壁，企圖在唐軍立足未穩時一舉衝垮堡壘；若正面受阻便分兵迂回，尋找水源、草場與替代隘口繞行。補給上，聯軍靠游牧方式就地取糧，損失補充較快，但戰區內可用水源僅疏勒河下游與諸泉，一旦水場被唐軍切斷，優勢便迅速流失。
tacticsEn: The Tang plan ran on a sequence of holding the point, drawing the enemy in, sealing the mouth and counterstriking. Xue Rengui first took the forts and beacon towers around Guazhou and placed crossbows and foot archers in the gaps between the camps and in the gullies leading up the valley, so that the Tibetan and Karluq federated army could not deploy all at once. When the coalition came down the Shule river valley and along the Gobi tracks to the narrows, the Tang infantry closed the front with long spears, the crossbows sealed the flanking passages and the slope, and massed arrows wore down the leading riders. The decisive stroke was the picked horse under Ashina Daozhen: instead of grinding away on the front, they cut in from the high ground behind the fort or from the dry riverbeds, striking the flanks and the baggage train of the coalition, cutting the column into sections and forcing it to abandon the attack. In the pursuit the Tang did not attempt to annihilate; they cut the road of retreat and forced the enemy to leave tents and wounded behind. The coalition's tactics were the classic highland and steppe three-dimensional operation, with Karluq cavalry as a fast spearhead crashing into the Tang flanks and the main body of Tibetan foot and horse formed behind them into thick walls, in the hope of overwhelming the fort before the Tang could settle in; when the front was checked they split off to make turning movements, seeking water, pasture and alternative gorges to come round. In supply they lived off the land in the nomadic fashion and could replace losses quickly, but the water of the battlefield was limited to the lower Shule and its springs, and once the water and pasture were cut off by the Tang, the advantage drained away fast.
data: 史籍留下的數字多帶戰報性質，只宜當量級來看。《舊唐書》記吐蕃與葛邏祿之眾二十餘萬來寇安西，這個數字顯然把游牧部眾的家屬、部伍與未投入戰鬥的人員一併計入；同一段記載又稱唐軍斬首萬餘級、俘獲甚眾，斬獲數與出兵數同樣難以核實。可以確定的是兩端的兵力形狀：唐方以安西留使直屬的漢兵與都護府屬下胡兵為先頭，河西節度使的兵與長安、隴右調發的援軍在後，總數遠不足以與宣傳中的二十餘萬在野外交鋒，所以唐軍採取據城、以弩砲封隘口、以精騎擊其一部的消耗戰法。時間上，開元十五年春薛仁貴出任安西留使，秋冬之交聯軍入寇，交戰集中在十月至十一月的一兩日，追擊又拖了數日，之後聯軍退回天山南北。距離上，安西治所龜茲到瓜州一線逾千里，隴右軍需經長安的驛道與河西的烽燧接力，單程以日行數十里計，軍隊往還與糧草調運都以月計；瓜州距沙州治所敦煌約二百餘里，正是唐蕃邊防的接合處。此外可比的，是雙方裝備結構的差距：唐軍重裝少而弩、弓、具裝騎兵與步卒編制完整，聯軍騎兵多而甲兵與攻城器相對薄弱，這一差距在隘口地形上被放大成決定性的潰敗。
dataEn: The figures the histories preserve carry the character of battle reports and are best read as orders of magnitude. The Old Book of Tang says the Tibetan and Karluq host came with more than two hundred thousand, a number that plainly counts the families, camp followers and uncommitted levy contingents of the nomads as if they were combatants; the same passage gives the Tang over ten thousand heads cut and many prisoners taken, figures equally impossible to verify. What can be fixed is the shape of the two forces. On the Tang side the advance was made by Han troops of the Resident Commissioner and by the Hu soldiers of the protectorate, with the troops of the Hexi circuit and the reinforcements from Chang'an and Longyou behind them, and their total was far too small to stand up to the advertised host in open field, so the Tang fought a war of position, sealing the passes with crossbows and striking the enemy piecemeal with picked horse. In time, Xue Rengui took up the post of Resident Commissioner of Anxi in the spring of Kaiyuan 15, the coalition crossed the frontier in the last months of that year, the fighting itself occupied a day or two in the tenth or eleventh month, the pursuit dragged on for several more days, and the coalition then withdrew into the Tian Shan. In distance, from the Anxi seat at Kucha to the Guazhou line is well over a thousand li, and supplies from Longyou travelled by the post road out of Chang'an and the beacon relay of Hexi at a few tens of li a day, so the movement of troops or grain was measured in months; the town of Guazhou lies a little over two hundred li from the seat of Shazhou at Dunhuang, exactly where the Tang and Tibetan frontiers met. One further comparison is safe: the Tang had little heavy cavalry but full establishments of crossbowmen, archers, armoured horse and disciplined foot, while the coalition had many riders and thin armour and siege equipment, and on broken ground that gap was magnified into a decisive rout.
cause: 瓜州之戰不是偶發的邊境衝突，而是唐、吐蕃、葛邏祿三方在西域北緣爭奪的一段。赤松德贊普時期，吐蕃完成了對吐谷渾與西域的整合，唐則以安西都護府四鎮與河西節度使構成自己的邊防框架，兩套體系的邊界在塔里木盆地東緣與河西走廊西段長期互相擠壓。開元十五年前後，葛邏祿部在突騎施與葛邏祿的分裂中站到吐蕃一方，其騎隊多次深入塔里木與河西東口，成為吐蕃的先鋒；唐廷則同時用冊封羈縻與加強安西防務兩手試圖把這支部眾拉回自己的框架，封葛邏祿首領為葉護、於其地設州置鎮，雙方的爭奪在瓜州一線正面碰撞。經濟與生態的推力同樣具體：西域綠洲的稅糧與絲路商路是唐廷不能失去的收入，吐蕃要的是能養兵的高原與綠洲通道，而瓜州所在的疏勒河下游正是這條河的終點綠洲與水源，一條河的水量足以決定一支軍隊能待多久。於是在沒有正式宣戰的情況下，兩人以邊軍屯田、劫掠、奪堡、驅趶牲畜的方式，把一場帝國級的邊境對抗壓縮成了具體的一仗。
causeEn: The Battle of Guazhou was not a chance border clash but a stage in the three-way struggle of Tang, Tibet and the Karluq on the northern rim of the western regions. In the reign of Tri Songdetsen, Tibet completed its consolidation of Tuyuhun and the Tarim Basin, while Tang built its frontier frame of the four garrisons of Anxi and the Hexi Circuit, and the two systems pressed against each other along the eastern edge of the Tarim and the western end of the Hexi corridor for years. Around Kaiyuan 15 the Karluq, in the split between the Türgesh and the Karluq, sided with Tibet, and their horsemen drove deep into the Tarim and the eastern mouths of Hexi again and again, serving as the Tibetan spearhead. The Tang court at the same time tried to draw that people back into its own framework by two means at once, investiture and control on the one hand and a stronger Anxi defence on the other, granting the Karluq chief the title of yabghu and establishing prefectures and garrisons in their land, and the two efforts collided head on at the Guazhou line. The economic and ecological pressures were just as concrete: the tax of the oasis towns and the traffic of the silk road were revenue the court could not lose, Tibet wanted the plateau and the green corridors that would feed an army, and the lower Shule, where Guazhou stood, was the terminal oasis and the water of that river, and the flow of a single river decided how long a force could remain. So without any formal declaration of war, through frontier farming, raids, the seizure of forts and the driving off of cattle, the two sides compressed an imperial border rivalry into one concrete battle.
impact: 此役的結果沒有改變中亞的權力格局，卻改了唐蕃在河西走廊西段的實際界線。吐蕃聯軍在瓜州受挫後退回天山南北，唐得以把安西都護府與河西節度使的防線重新連成一條能運作的邊防鏈條，疏勒河下游的水源與草場暫時保住，敦煌一帶的漢地屯田與驛傳得以延續；葛邏祿一部西附大食、一部北走，遊牧聯盟的組合方式也為後來突騎施的興起埋下伏筆。對唐廷內部而言，薛仁貴以少制眾、據城待敵的戰法，恰好為玄宗朝正在摸索的西域政策提供了一個可複製的範本：以安西大將鎮守、以少量精騎打游牧大軍、避免正面會戰消耗，後來安西與河西的歷次戰事多沿用這一思路。對吐蕃而言，這是一次必須重新計算成本的失敗，赤松德贊普在七三〇年代轉向唐蕃邊界的其他方向，包括向大食求婚、與南詔往來，其後唐蕃在青海一線再度衝突，那已是另一個時代的問題。就兵器史而言，此役也留下一個耐人尋味的對照：羅馬人用單發扭力弩砲拆掉希臘城牆，改寫了地中海的城邦政治；八百年後，同源技術的弩砲在瓜州封住幾條隘道，卻無法改變一場帝國對抗的走向，決定勝負的變數早已從弓弩移到騎兵、糧草、聯盟與行政效率上。
impactEn: The outcome changed no balance of power in Central Asia, but it changed the practical line that Tang and Tibet held in the western Hexi corridor. Beaten at Guazhou, the Tibetan and Karluq coalition withdrew into the Tian Shan, and Tang could once more join the Protectorate of Anxi and the Hexi Circuit into a single working chain of frontier defence; the water and the pasture of the lower Shule were kept for the time being, and the Han farms and post stations around Dunhuang continued. Part of the Karluq went west to the caliphate and part went north, and the way the tribal coalition had been assembled prefigured the later rise of the Türgesh. Inside the Tang the victory gave the court a repeatable model for the western policy it was still formulating in the reign of Xuanzong: hold the frontier with a great general at Anxi, use a small body of picked horse against nomadic hosts, and refuse the costly frontal battle, a line that later campaigns in Anxi and Hexi followed. For Tibet it was a failure that forced a recalculation of costs, and in the 730s Tri Songdetsen turned to other directions of the Tang-Tibetan frontier, among them the marriage embassy to the caliphate and the ties with Nanzhao; the later clashes over Qinghai belonged to a different age. For the history of weapons the episode leaves a suggestive contrast: Rome broke the walls of Greek cities with a single-shot torsion engine and so rewrote the politics of the Mediterranean city-state, while eight centuries later the descendant of that engine sealed a few passes at Guazhou and could not turn the course of an imperial contest, for the decisive variables had long since moved from bow and crossbow to cavalry, supply, alliance and administrative efficiency.
result: 開元十五年冬，聯軍在瓜州一線被唐軍擊潰。唐軍據城而守，以弩砲與弓弩封住谷口與營壘之間的通道，待聯軍鋪成縱隊、指揮被切斷之後，由阿史那道真所率的精騎反覆衝擊其側翼與退路，聯軍遂放棄進攻，帶著殘部退回天山南北。唐軍沒有深入越境追擊，只追至瓜州以西的戈壁地帶，迫使對方丟下帳具、輜重與受傷的人馬；史籍記唐軍斬首萬餘級、俘獲甚眾，這些數字應作量級而非精確統計看待。吐蕃聯軍的統帥論悉諾退回本境，葛邏祿首領阿悉得多率部眾西遷，隨後十餘年間葛邏祿在塔里木盆地北緣幾度易主，或附大食，或歸突騎施，唐對其的羈縻冊封也就此落空。薛仁貴因功受到朝廷褒獎，加封邑戶、賞賜帛，聲名更盛，他在西域的歲月不長，回到長安後仍以安西大都護的名望被朝廷倚重。對雙方而言，瓜州之戰是一次清楚的告誡：攻守之易，不在城池之堅，而在能不能把水、馬、糧草與指揮體系捏成一條不斷的鏈條；羅馬弩砲那樣一發一矢的精密器械，在這樣的戰爭裡只能守一段路，不能贏一場戰爭。
resultEn: In the winter of Kaiyuan 15 the coalition was broken on the Guazhou line. The Tang held their positions, sealing the mouths of the gullies and the gaps between the camps with crossbows and bows, and once the federated army had stretched out in column and its command was cut, the picked horse under Ashina Daozhen struck its flanks and its road of retreat again and again, until the enemy gave up the attack and withdrew with what was left of them into the Tian Shan. The Tang did not pursue deep across the border, following only as far as the Gobi west of Guazhou and so forcing the enemy to leave tents, baggage and wounded men behind; the histories give over ten thousand heads cut and many prisoners taken, and these numbers are best read as magnitude rather than as exact counts. The Tibetan commander Lun Xinu fell back to his own country and the Karluq chief Axi Duo led his people westward; over the following ten years or more the Karluq changed hands several times on the northern edge of the Tarim, some years serving the caliphate and some years the Türgesh, and the Tang plan of control by investiture lapsed. Xue Rengui was rewarded by the court, granted additional fiefs and fine silks, and his fame grew; his years in the west were short, and back in Chang'an he was still relied on for the standing of a great protector of Anxi. For both sides the battle of Guazhou was a plain lesson: the balance of attack and defence is not settled by the strength of a wall but by whether water, horses, grain and command can be held in one unbroken chain, and a precision weapon like the Roman scorpio, one bolt at a time, could hold a stretch of road in a war like this but never win a war like this.
